# MarketTwits News x402 API

Paid real-time Russian and global market news from the MarketTwits Telegram channel (translated to English), plus Bank of Russia FX rates, Moscow Exchange quotes, Rosstat data, public Telegram channels, and Wildberries/Ozon product information.

Base URL: https://x402-markettwits-news.onrender.com
Payment: USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402
OpenAPI: https://x402-markettwits-news.onrender.com/openapi.json
Agents: https://x402-markettwits-news.onrender.com/agents.json
MCP: npx -y x402-markettwits-mcp

## Main paid endpoints
- GET /news/latest — latest translated MarketTwits news
- GET /news/important — high-importance news only
- GET /news/search?q= — keyword search in news
- GET /news/summary?q= — short English summary of latest news on a topic
- GET /news/digest — sectioned briefing (central banks, macro, energy, equities, crypto, geopolitics)
- GET /ru/fx?codes=USD — official Bank of Russia FX rates
- GET /moex/quote?ticker=SBER — Moscow Exchange stock quote
- GET /tg/channel/latest?channel=... — latest posts from a public Telegram channel
- GET /product/info?url=... — Wildberries / Ozon product card (title, price, rating, stock)
- GET /product/compare?urls=... — compare several products
- GET /product/history?url=... — price history

All endpoints require x402 payment in USDC on Base. Prices range from $0.001 to $0.005 per call.
